description:
Late punctuation neither amends a sent request nor creates another task. The voice call is faked. In an eval, window.liveEmit(event) delivers event from Live (e.g. window.liveEmit({type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "Hello ", start_ms: 0, end_ms: 400})); emit each event in its own eval, in the order given. window.liveSpeak(id, speech) speaks and delegates: it emits {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: speech, start_ms: 0, end_ms: 900} and then {type: "session.delegation.created", offset_ms: 900, delegation: {id, target: "client"}}. window.liveNotes() returns the JSON of everything Shelley sent to Live. window.__voiceTracksStopped counts the microphone tracks stopped. "Start the call" means: click data-testid "live-call-header"; data-testid "live-bar" should contain "On call". "The exchange" is data-testid "live-exchange". "The message X" is the [data-testid="message"] elements whose text contains X (has_text; it collapses whitespace, so a line break is a space). Text checks on messages and the exchange compare whitespace-collapsed text: eval el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").includes(...) with expect true (or false for "not contain"), on every matching element. Call "history" describes the conversation as the server has it. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/punctuation and start the call.
2. Call window.liveSpeak("punctuation", "echo: keep the period"). There should be exactly one message "Spoken request: echo: keep the period" (the request).
3. Emit {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: ".", start_ms: 850, end_ms: 900}, then {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "Next thought.", start_ms: 5000, end_ms: 6000}. The exchange should contain "Next thought.", and must contain neither ".Next thought." nor ". Next thought.".
4. Click data-testid "live-stop". Call "history" should return exactly {"livetranscript":false,"continued":false} (no livetranscript message, and nothing says "Spoken request (continued)"). The request must not contain "USER: echo: keep the period.".
5. Navigate to /c/punctuation again (a reload). The request must not contain "USER: echo: keep the period.".
